summary: Iter-7 RETEST after iter6 fixes: ALL THREE blockers/minor issues from iter6 are RESOLVED. (1) OTPVerification now syncs setCode(dev_code) inside sendCode() and Input is fully controlled (value={code}) — verified end-to-end /signup → phone → OTP auto-fill → Verify → /dashboard redirect with token persisted in localStorage. (2) /referrals redirects unauthenticated users to /login (no more 401 spam). (3) Earned label correctly renders '(TTD)' when currency present and hides parens when undefined. (4) Delivery Address `required` removed — signup completes without it. Admin /admin tabs Approvals/Zones/WhatsApp all render with data-testid; Zones tab successfully creates a new zone (Active Zones count went 1→2) and WhatsApp tab loads conversation list from backend. Backend regression 158/158 pytest PASS in 74s.

ReferralPage.js redirect on 401/403 OR missing token via useNavigate is correct and prevents the 401-spam loop.
